scope_note: This catalog covers every architecture identifier in the ISA database, including duplicate aliases, extensions, GPUs and virtual ISAs. It is not a claim that every row is a general-purpose CPU, an OS port, a supported Koronos target, or a unique commercial processor model. CISC/RISC are descriptive labels, not a complete taxonomy.
